newsitem.title: UK: Iceland says year-to-date sales up 0.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: Iceland says year-to-date sales up 0.5 pct.

text.p: British supermarket chain Iceland Group Plc, posting a sharp drop in profits, said on Wednesday its like-for-like sales in the year-to-date were up 0.5 percent versus the year-ago period.
The company said its 1996 pre-tax profit fell 22.6 percent to 56.2 million stg, hit by what it called unsatisfactory like-for-like sales.
Iceland said its like-for-like sales in 1996 were slightly up over the year in cash terms but down by about 1.2 percent in volume.
"After 25 years of consistent profit growth, 1996 brought the first setback in Iceland's history," the firm said in a statement.
"We have launched a number of exciting new initiatives and are confident that these will contribute to an improved performance in 1997," it added.
Iceland said it expected capital expenditure of about 64 million stg in 1997, down from 68 million stg last year and 66 million stg in 1995.
